info.title: triad WebSocket API
info.description: `triad serve` exposes one chat session on a WebSocket at `/v1`. HTTP is used only for the upgrade; every request and event is a JSON text frame, described by `Request` and `Event` under components. API.md is the prose reference (routing, close codes, the reconnect recipe). Generate client types from `components.schemas`.

get.description: A WebSocket upgrade (RFC 6455). Send `Request` frames; receive `Event` frames, starting with `hello` then `ready`. Without an `Authorization` header, the first frame must be an `AuthRequest` within 5 seconds.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Sent by browsers. Refused with 403 unless the server was started with `--allow-origin` for it.

408.description: The request head did not arrive within 5 seconds.

431.description: The request head is over 8 KiB.

bearer.description: The 64-hex-character token in `<data-dir>/api-token`. Browsers cannot set this header; they send an `AuthRequest` first instead.

OpHash.description: An operation hash, 32 bytes hex. Unique per message; the key for de-duplication and the `history` cursor.

RequestId.description: Chosen by the client; echoed as `re` on every reply.

seq.description: Per-process frame counter. Gaps are frames sent to other clients or missed.

FrameMeta.description: Fields the socket adds to every event.

AuthRequest.description: The first frame, when the token was not sent in an `Authorization: Bearer` header. Needs no `id`; `hello` acknowledges it.

SendRequest.description: Publishes a message (an action, like `/me`, when `action`). Never read as an answer to a join request.

HistoryRequest.description: Stored messages before `before` (newest when absent), oldest first.

CommandRequest.description: Runs a `/command` as if typed with `channel` focused (the session's default channel when absent). `/quit`, `/switch`, `/s` and `/debug-*` are refused.

Request.description: A client-to-server text frame: one JSON object.

HelloEvent.description: First frame on every connection, before `ready`.

ReadyEvent.description: The session: its default channel's fields at the top level, every channel in `channels`. Sent on connect and in answer to `snapshot`.

DoneEvent.description: Ends every request, exactly once. `error` is set when `ok` is false.

HistoryEvent.description: Answer to `history`: up to `limit` messages before the cursor, oldest first.

LaggedEvent.description: This client fell more than 1024 frames behind. Sent just before closing with 4008; `seq` is the first frame it did not get.

MessageEvent.description: A chat message, stored and shown. Your own messages arrive here too (`mine: true`) once published.

InfoEvent.description: A note for a person. Under a request it answers that request.

ErrorEvent.description: Something failed. Under a request, the request's `done` carries the same text.

ChannelEvent.description: A channel was added (`/create`, `/join`, the bot DM).

SwitchedEvent.description: The session's focus moved. Never sent over the socket: `/switch` is refused there.

JoinedEvent.description: A member is in the channel (including this node, when its space opens).

RemovedEvent.description: A member left or was removed.

JoinRequestEvent.description: Someone asks to join a channel this node manages. Answer with the `answer` op unless `auto`.

JoinDeclinedEvent.description: A join request was declined: `bot DM` (never admitted) or `declined` (an `answer` with `accept: false`).

SyncStartedEvent.description: Log sync with a peer began.

SyncEndedEvent.description: Log sync with a peer ended.

ToolCallEvent.description: A bot turn called a tool.

JobEvent.description: A bot turn's state. `done` carries timings and token counts.

BotUnavailableEvent.description: This session's bots could not start.

BotsStartedEvent.description: The bots started or changed provider.

BotOnEvent.description: A channel's bot was turned on.

BotOffEvent.description: A channel's bot was turned off.

BotRejectedEvent.description: A bot claim from someone other than the channel's host was not accepted.

BlockedEvent.description: A member was blocked from the bot.

ScheduleFiredEvent.description: A schedule of the personal bot fired.

ScheduleMissedEvent.description: A schedule was too late to run.

Event.description: A server-to-client text frame: one JSON object. Clients must ignore events and fields they do not know.

x-close-codes.1001: the session ended, or no answer to pings
